description: Same estimated 3S installation as electric-3s-1250kv-9x6-estimated-v1, mounted as a pusher in a slot behind the wing, as on foam park jets. The mirrored pusher propeller is assumed to share the tractor tables. Propeller wash, the fuselage wake on the disc and ducted-fan behaviour are not modelled.

resistance_ohm.source: SunnySky X2212-10 1250 kV II listing (getfpv.com/sunnysky-x2212-10-1250kv-ii.html): internal resistance

no_load_current_a.source: SunnySky X2212-10 1250 kV II listing (getfpv.com/sunnysky-x2212-10-1250kv-ii.html): no-load current (low confidence: variants differ)

no_load_voltage_v.source: SunnySky X2212-10 1250 kV II listing (getfpv.com/sunnysky-x2212-10-1250kv-ii.html): no-load test voltage

resistance_ohm.source: About 7 milliohm per cell for a 2200 mAh 25-30C pack (catalogue class)

auxiliary_current_a.source: Receiver and four 9 g servos at rest

ocv_points.source: Linear 3.0 to 4.2 V per cell over state of charge, as in the 4S package

rotating_inertia.source: 12 g 9 in propeller as a slender rod m·D²/12 = 5.2e-5 plus about 0.8e-5 for a 22 mm motor bell

ct_table.source: Borrowed: nondimensional UIUC APC Sport 11x6 table (apcsp_11x6_static_rd0488.txt, apcsp_11x6_rd0495_6000.txt) applied to a 9x6 by T = Ct·ρ·n²·D⁴ and P = Cp·ρ·n³·D⁵: no UIUC table for this propeller is in the repository; P/D 0.67 against 0.55 and a lower chord Reynolds number make it an estimate

cp_table.source: Borrowed: nondimensional UIUC APC Sport 11x6 table (apcsp_11x6_static_rd0488.txt, apcsp_11x6_rd0495_6000.txt) applied to a 9x6 by T = Ct·ρ·n²·D⁴ and P = Cp·ρ·n³·D⁵: no UIUC table for this propeller is in the repository; P/D 0.67 against 0.55 and a lower chord Reynolds number make it an estimate

motor_behind_hub.source: Pusher: motor centre ahead of the propeller hub by a 0.01 m adapter plus half of a 0.03 m outrunner (applied forward)

firewall_behind_hub.source: Pusher: motor front face ahead of the propeller hub by a 0.01 m adapter plus a 0.03 m outrunner (applied forward)

spinner_length.source: Prop nut behind the hub, for the crash-hull tail point

mass.source: SunnySky X2212-10 1250 kV II listing (getfpv.com/sunnysky-x2212-10-1250kv-ii.html): 56-58 g
9x6 propeller about 0.012 kg plus prop adapter

size.source: 9 in propeller envelope for intrinsic inertia

mass.source: Typical 30 A brushless speed controller with leads

size.source: Typical 3S 2200 mAh pack envelope, long axis fore-aft
